$Comment: A spot a panel can sit at: the top-left, at the same origin as the zone card another mod
draws there, deliberately OVER it: the panel is transparent behind its frame, it attaches after
the card so it draws on top, and the two read fine stacked, whereas sitting below the card and
the mob inspector would push the ledger halfway down the screen. Measured for the Activity
ledger (Activity_Ledger, which sits here as shipped) and offered to the World bars too: one
narrow column until the column is full (thirteen rows), then a second one beside it rather
than running off the bottom of the screen.
MinHeight is the least height a panel draws at here, whatever its rows add up to. It matches
that zone card, so a ledger of one or two rows still covers the card rather than leaving its
lower half showing beneath a shorter frame; a busier ledger grows past it as usual. Leave it
out on a spot with nothing beneath it.
Position is a corner preset (TopLeft, TopCenter, TopRight, CenterLeft, Center, CenterRight,
BottomLeft, BottomCenter, BottomRight) plus pixel offsets from the edges that preset pins; the
preset names a corner of the screen and is not the spot's id, so a spot of your own may pin
any corner whatever it is called. Columns and RowsPerColumn say how the rows spread out here;
a panel never opens more columns than its own document declares, nor fills a column deeper
than its document allows. Gap leaves a band clear across the rows after so many of them,
counted from the pinned edge, and Cutout leaves the cells at one column's pinned end empty
(see Bottom_Left.json, which uses both). Panels lists which panels offer this spot; leave it
out to offer it to every panel. LabelKey names the spot in the HUD settings, in each player's
own language, and Order is where it is listed among the spots, lower first.
To change a leaf without copying this file, add an entry keyed 'Top_Left' to
mods/ziggfreedcommon/hud-spots.json with only the leaves you want different. To add a spot
of your own, drop another file in this folder: every picker offers it at once.
